name: Pomar de Valdivia (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and white, the red charged with thirteen white roundels and the white with two blue wavy stripes.
history: Municipal flag of Pomar de Valdivia; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: thirteen roundels arranged in rows of 3, 3, 3, 3 and 1
two wavy stripes on the white
